SELECT (SELECT KYINT FROM SYSALTER WHERE KEY1 = 'EC' AND KEY2 = 'SYS' AND KEY3 = 'SYSSTATUS') AS SYSSTATUS , (SELECT IBF_GET_PARAMNAME('SYSTEM', 'SYSSTATUS', KYINT) FROM SYSALTER WHERE KEY1 = 'EC' AND KEY2 = 'SYS' AND KEY3 = 'SYSSTATUS') AS SYSSTATUSNAME, (SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(KYDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM SYSALTER WHERE KEY1 = 'EC' AND KEY2 ='SYS' AND KEY3 ='LASTDATE') AS LASTDATE, (SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(KYDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM SYSALTER WHERE KEY1 = 'EC' AND KEY2 ='SYS' AND KEY3 ='WORKDATE') AS WORKDATE, (SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(KYDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM SYSALTER WHERE KEY1 = 'EC' AND KEY2 ='SYS' AND KEY3 ='NEXTDATE') AS NEXTDATE FROM DUAL
